decisions.reason: The source adds a connector to the integrated-board design, not the separate main-board connector inventory.
Adding one required connector does not change the existing cost goal, component-tier preference, or general objective of using fewer connectors than the multi-board design.
The all-connectors through-hole policy already covers any added connector, and the source does not change its assembly type or coverage.
The source concerns the integrated board and does not identify any change to the separate sensor-board connector topology or count.
The added connector may require placement work, but the source specifies no change to orientation, edge placement, enclosure, or antenna constraints.
The source does not identify the omitted connector as J_DISP_LED or change any backlight-circuit requirement.
The source does not identify the omitted JST-GH connector as the light-sensor port, and the existing requirement already specifies one such port.
The source concerns the integrated-board connector set and does not change the separate main-board panel-control connectors or mappings.
Adding a peripheral connector leaves the single-board architecture and functional-consolidation requirement unchanged.
The source does not change charging behavior, required power rails, battery efficiency, or the selected power-management component.
The source does not identify the added integrated-board connector as the panel power-control connector or change that control's behavior.
The additional peripheral connector does not alter the current-measurement capability or INA omission condition.
